en.title: Top K Elements in Original Order
en.description:
Select the K largest elements of the array and output them in their original relative order. When equal values straddle the cutoff, prefer the ones that appear earliest, so that exactly K are chosen. These rules are stated in full in the source problem's two example explanations.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol; ranges not given by the source are stated explicitly.
en.input: The first line contains N K, and the second line contains N integers. The source only gives 0≤K≤N; this site uses 1≤N≤100000 and elements in −10⁹..10⁹.
en.output: Output exactly K values in their original relative order; output an empty line when K is 0.
en.explanation: Example 1: choose indices 0, 2, 3 and output them in original order as 5 3 5. Example 2: take the earliest two of the three 4s and output 4 4. Example 3: K is 0, so output an empty line.
hints: Pick K indices by value in descending order and index in ascending order, then sort these indices in ascending order and output the corresponding elements.
